title: Wan 3.0 joins video generation
summary:
Wan 3.0 and an FFmpeg agent tool arrived alongside better Pollen earnings tools and more precise model information.

Added paid-only `wan-3.0` for five-second text-to-video and image-to-video clips, with optional audio and 480p, 720p, or 1080p output. Video requests now reject frames beyond a model’s registered limit instead of silently ignoring them. Identical image-generation requests can also retrieve completed cached media without an API key.

A hosted FFmpeg MCP gives prompt agents a `runFfmpeg` tool for processing media from public HTTPS URLs and returning hosted outputs. It supports common video, audio, and image formats, with 100 MB input and output limits and a 110-second run limit.

Quest contributions added typed SDK access to developer earnings and account Quests, plus a `polli earnings` command with per-entity totals and JSON output. The SDK also preserves request IDs from error headers when a response body omits them. Contributor guidance now clarifies that multiple approaches to an open Quest can be submitted before one is selected.

highlights.title: Wan 3.0 video
highlights.text: Generate five-second videos from a prompt or a start image with `wan-3.0`. Choose 480p, 720p, or 1080p, with optional audio. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan-3.0).

highlights.title: FFmpeg tools for agents
highlights.text: Prompt agents can use `runFfmpeg` to process media from public HTTPS URLs and receive hosted video, audio, or image output. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Check your Pollen earnings
highlights.text: Use SDK `accountEarnings()` or `polli earnings` to inspect Pollen earned by BYOP apps and community models, including per-entity request counts. The CLI also offers JSON output for scripts. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Quests in the SDK
highlights.text: Use `accountQuests()` to fetch the Quest catalog with your account’s status, reward details, and claim timestamps. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Look up one model
highlights.text: Fetch a model by canonical ID or alias with the OpenAI-compatible `GET /v1/models/:model` endpoint. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
